title: The Rain Makers
description: A charged Youth Service message calling the next generation to rise as rain makers — those through whom God releases His blessings upon the earth. Anchored in Leviticus 26:23, the message challenges young believers to walk in God's statutes and position themselves as conduits of His due-season rain.

title: Speak Your Due Season
description: Pastor Babarinde delivers a stirring charge to speak God's promises into your waiting season. Anchored in Leviticus 26:4 — 'I will pour you rain in your due season' — and Revelation 21:5–6, the message calls believers to declare life over delayed blessings and trust God to make all things new.
speaker: Pastor Babarinde

image.alt: Pastor Babarinde preaching at Shiloh Mega Parish

title: Rain of Restoration in Our Due Season
description: A powerful message on God's faithfulness to restore all that has been lost — in His perfect timing, the rain of restoration will fall.
speaker: Pastor Moses Olise

image.alt: Pastor Moses Olise preaching Rain of Restoration at Shiloh Mega Parish

title: This is not the end
description: Finding hope and new beginnings in Christ. Discover how God's promises bring light even in the darkest moments.
speaker: Pastor Moses Olise

title: Hope in Hard Times
description: Finding strength and hope when life gets difficult.
speaker: Pastor Caroline Olise
